landing.privacyNoticeBody: This session is temporary. Your answers may contain sensitive personal data. Please do not provide information unrelated to the form. The session will automatically expire and be deleted after inactivity. No data is automatically submitted to third-party authorities. You must review the final summary before completing. By proceeding, you agree to these terms.
